description.p: opencode-tether is an unofficial, independent hobby project that puts a native, mobile-first remote interface on top of opencode. Connect to a local or remote opencode host, manage sessions, follow agent output, and answer tool permissions from a phone, tablet, or desktop.
It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the opencode project. The opencode mark is used only to identify the service this app connects to.
The recommended setup is the Rust host shim on the machine running opencode. It serves this app and proxies the opencode API behind a single login.
First public release: remote management, host mode, live sessions, model and agent selection, permission prompts, and native Android and desktop builds.
